Both phone numbers can make and receive voice and FaceTime calls. They can also send and receive messages using iMessage, SMS, and MMS. 1 Your iPhone can use one cellular data network at a time. What you need An iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR, or later In China mainland, only iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Duo, iPhone 17e, and iPhone Air support eSIM. Learn about using eSIM with your iPhone in China mainland. In Hong Kong and Macao, certain iPhone models feature Dual SIM with two nano-SIM cards . A wireless carrier that supports eSIM To use two carriers, your carrier must unlock your iPhone, or both plans must be from the same carrier. Contact your carrier for details. If you have an enterprise or corporate cellular service plan, check with your company administrator to see if they support this feature. Set up another cellular plan on your iPhone Use two phone numbers Learn about Dual SIM status icons Change your cellular data number Manage cellular settings Erase your eSIM Set up another cellular plan on your iPhone You can use Dual SIM by using a physical SIM and an eSIM. iPhone 13 models and later also support Dual SIM with two eSIMs, in addition to a physical SIM and an eSIM. Learn how to activate a cellular plan on an eSIM . Travel internationally with Dual SIM You can also use Dual SIM while traveling internationally with your iPhone. For example, you can use one number for your home line and another for your travel line. With iOS 26 and later, if you download a travel eSIM, you might experience a customized travel eSIM set up journey. Learn how to stay connected in the country or region you’re visiting . Label your plans After you activate your second plan, label your plans. For example, you can label one plan Business and the other plan Personal. You'll use these labels to choose which phone number to use for calls and messages. You can designate a number for cellular data and assign a number to your contacts. That way, you know which number you will use. If you change your mind later, you can change your labels: Open the Settings app. Tap either Cellular or Mobile Data.
